allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Navy Lt. Tom Farrell meets a young woman, Susan Atwell, and they share a passionate fling. Farrell then finds out that his superior, Defense Secretary David Brice, is also romantically involved with Atwell. When the young woman turns up dead, Farrell is put in charge of the murder investigation. He begins to uncover shocking clues about the case, but when details of his encounter with Susan surface, he becomes a suspect as well.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Assigned to head a high-stakes homicide probe, an investigator discovers that the clues he uncovers are steadily assembling a case against himself.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After a passionate liaison with a woman who is also seeing the Secretary of Defense, Navy Lt. Tom Farrell is assigned to lead her murder inquiry, only to find the evidence pointing straight back to him.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Suspenseful and tightly wound, this steady 1987 thriller delivers moderate emotional weight and high-pressure investigative tension.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Roger Donaldson crafts a sharp, suspenseful political thriller where a military investigator must solve a homicide while actively dodging his own growing entrapment.
